name: Self-Evaluation, Task Verification & Recovery Engine
purpose: Self-evaluating reasoning quality, verifying task completion, detecting uncertainty, and executing automated recovery fallbacks.
registration: TaraBrain::new initializes evaluators and binds recovery hooks.
discovery: Post-generation hook triggers evaluation cycle on every output.
storage: Evaluation scores appended to turn metadata in memory episodes.
memory_link: Evaluation metrics provide quality labels for episodic memory storage.
learning_link: High-scoring turns prioritized for continual training replay.
self_evolution_link: Frequent uncertainty detections trigger autonomous topic research.
curriculum_link: Evaluation rubrics mirror 35-point dataset intelligence criteria.
safety_gates: Refusal to claim success when TaskVerifier detects derivation mismatch
Uncertainty threshold forces explicit disclosure of low confidence to user

lifecycle.1_intercept: Intercept generated response before final emission
lifecycle.2_verify: TaskVerifier compares response against specialist derivations and constraint bounds
lifecycle.3_uncertainty: UncertaintyDetector computes confidence score from output token entropy
lifecycle.4_evaluate: SelfEvaluator scores reasoning depth, factual alignment, and clarity
lifecycle.5_recover: If verification fails, RecoveryEngine triggers backtracking or fallback strategy
lifecycle.6_tag: Attach evaluation scorecard to turn record in memory hub
